svg.title: How πMPC updates the prediction horizon
svg.desc: Interactive ADMM schedule with word explanations, CPU and GPU work allocation, illustrative consensus residuals, and equations. Three representative columns show parallel horizon stages and ordered update phases.
svg.text: πMPC · one horizon, parallel stage updates
Choose a phase to see what is computed together and where information crosses stages.
